items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...January '36 [Stew Fletcher] with Stew Fletcher, Donald McCork, Herbie Haymer, you, Dave Barbour, Pete Peterson, Bob White on drums, and Red.

ctx.x: It might have been. I always remember Maurice being there.
Yes; the first one had drums. Let's see, here's January '36 [Stew Fletcher] with Stew Fletcher, Donald McCork, Herbie Haymer, you, Dave Barbour, Pete Peterson, Bob White on drums, and Red.
